fact: In June 2023 the Bahmni EMR was in use at Tirunesh Beijing General Hospital and at Kazanchis, Saris and Ferensay health centres in Addis Ababa; a Ferensay nurse described working fully paperless, while staff at the hospital and other centres reported recording on the system after serving the patient and switching between paper and the EMR, which was not integrated with DHIS2.
title: Barriers and facilitators of the electronic medical record adoption among healthcare providers in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
